methodology_claims.claim: Of ~1,000 biotechs that reached $200M+ market cap over ~30 years, **~67% lost money**.
Biotech is a large share of small-cap universes and has **low pairwise correlation**
Traditional profit-based value and own-price momentum are **inverted** in biotech
Verdad built specialist holdings, insider disclosures, and a point-in-time set of
Specialist consensus (>50% biotech funds) is the primary biotech quality screen.
Prefer names owned by multiple specialists; unique single-fund ideas underperform consensus.
Traditional P/E value is inverted in biotech; use spend vs market cap instead.
Own-price momentum is inverted; use clinical peer-cohort momentum.
Insider buys matter when non-CEO (especially CFO); sells are mostly noise.
Short interest identifies losers; size shorts for diversification, not conviction.
13F lag is acceptable because specialist holds are multi-year and illiquid in small caps.
Small-cap specialist concentration carries more return than large-cap specialist dollars.
Blended quality + spend value + peer momentum spreads returns more than any single factor.
Biotech quant is an overlay; it does not replace Lawrence IRR for compounders.
Biotech overlay bans traditional metrics: pe_ratio, own_price_momentum_12m, ev_ebit.
